title: 第805章 什么叫做真正的天赋
slug: 宗门收徒我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

楚星尘看了眼谢灵玉的小表情已经没有那么紧绷，想来刚刚的小玩笑也缓解了谢灵玉难免的紧张。

毕竟面前站的可是一大群渡劫修士，迎接自己的也是超大的阵仗。

说怕自然是小瞧了谢灵玉，但是也不会谁在这种场面丢些脸面。

不过真论起来该紧张的其实如难才是。

这次来的人还真只有楚星尘和谢灵玉，白玄灵已经带着天道舆图忙活去了。

黄渺有空能来，可是黄渺也只是渡劫巅峰之境，如果佛门真要暴起，黄渺估计也得折在这里。

带了也是属于白带的状态，所以倒不如为表心意，也代表诚意就孤身带着谢灵玉来。

孤身来佛门，好处自然比坏处多。

楚星尘确保自己来佛门这段时间，如难得目光恐怕大部分都要放在他身上了。

他要是出点什么问题，整个佛门恐怕都要化为众矢之的了。

先不提真仙白玄灵，天衍宗和玄清天宗联手带着大义，下面还有一群渴望灵脉的次顶级仙宗，整个佛门定然要被扒一层皮。

如此之大的阵仗便是佐证，一来表示重视，二来表示极度的尊重。

没有人喜欢麻烦，除非解决这个麻烦能消除更大的麻烦。

例如他这次来大雷音寺也并非是自己想来，而是该要来了。

之前商议的小乘佛法推行在南瞻部洲就折了，明眼人大概也明白什么情况，这是要交代的。

其次唯有佛门的西牛贺洲安稳，加之佛门的渡劫修士最多。

这股力量自然尽量要被调动起来，最好直接就去找波罗的麻烦，而且借口理由也好找——波罗在你们佛门不知道待了多少年了，真论熟悉波罗，世上再难有佛门能出其右了。

这也是上次会面会请佛门佛陀来的主要原因。

楚星尘抬头挺胸，脚步微微加快的向如难走去，同时语气温和道：

“如难道友，许久不见，甚是想念。”

如难面容和善轻轻点头，也顺嘴便夸奖道：

“楚道友风采不减当年，东海除魔天下皆知。”

“顺手的事。”楚星尘轻笑一声，语气轻松道，“今日阵仗好大，我受之有愧。”

Page (1/3)

Chu Xingchen glanced at Xie Lingyu, whose expression was no longer so tense. Thinking that the little joke just now relieved Xie Lingyu's unavoidable nervousness.

After all, there was a large group of tribulation-transcending monks standing in front of him, and what greeted him was also a huge formation.

To say he was afraid was to underestimate Xie Lingyu, but no one would lose face in such a scene.

But in truth, what should be stressful is actually difficult.

The only people who came this time were Chu Xingchen and Xie Lingyu. Bai Xuanling had already gone to work with the map of heaven.

Huang Miao can come when he has time, but Huang Miao is only at the peak of transcending tribulations. If Buddhism is really going to explode, Huang Miao will probably have to stay here.

Bringing it is also a leucorrhea state, so it is better to bring Xie Lingyu alone to show my love and sincerity.

Coming to Buddhism alone has more advantages than disadvantages.

Chu Xingchen made sure that during the time he came to Buddhism, most eyes would be on him.

If something goes wrong with him, the entire Buddhist sect may become the target of public criticism.

Not to mention the true immortal Bai Xuanling, the Tianyan Sect and the Xuanqing Tianzong have joined forces with great righteousness, and there are also a group of sub-top immortal sects who are eager for spiritual veins below. The entire Buddhist sect will definitely be skinned.

Such a large formation is evidence of this. Firstly, it shows attention, and secondly, it shows extreme respect.

No one likes trouble unless solving it eliminates a bigger trouble.

For example, he didn't come to Daleiyin Temple this time because he wanted to come, but because he was about to come.

The promotion of Hinayana Buddhism that was previously discussed has collapsed in Nanzhanbuzhou. Anyone with a discerning eye will probably understand what is going on, and this needs to be explained.

Secondly, only the Xiniu Hezhou of the Buddhist sect is safe, and the Buddhist sect has the most tribulation monks.

Naturally, this power must be mobilized as much as possible. It is best to go directly to trouble Polo, and the excuses are easy to find - Polo has been in your Buddhism for who knows how many years, and the truth is familiar with Polo. There is no Buddhist school in the world that can be better than him.

This is also the main reason why the Buddhist Buddha was invited to the last meeting.

Chu Xingchen raised his head, straightened his chest, walked toward Ru Nan with slightly faster steps, and said in a gentle tone:

"As if you are a friend, I haven't seen you for a long time and I miss you very much."

Ru Nan nodded gently with a kind face, and complimented him casually:

"Fellow Daoist Chu's demeanor remains the same as before, and he is known all over the world for slaying demons in the East China Sea."

"It's a convenient thing." Chu Xingchen chuckled and said in a relaxed tone, "The battle was huge today, and I deserve it."
